description: What the announcer says, by callout id. The arcade originals of the genre speak the start commands, fouls, qualifying, records and the Event names; these phrases follow them. PROVISIONAL: the wording hasn't been checked against a capture of the original yet; correct a phrase here and the game says it. Spoken with the browser's built-in speech synthesis (no recorded samples), at the rate and pitch given.
